[I have value = $18 and this is a second-price (Vickrey) auction. Bidding my true value is the safe, profit-maximizing strategy: if I win I pay the second-highest bid which will be ≤ my bid, so I never pay more than my value. Affiliation of signals suggests caution, but with one round and no history, truthful bidding maximizes expected surplus and avoids the winner's curse. I will bid my private value of 18. ]

[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction. My bid only affects whether I win; if I win I pay the second-highest bid. Bidding my true private value maximizes expected payoff and avoids overbidding (paying more than value) or underbidding (losing positive surplus). Despite the common component, payment does not depend on my bid. I will bid my true value: $23.
